text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the final moments before the race, Taiki Shuttle can only think about running her heart out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to beat Silence Suzuka, and—above all—to become the next Umamusume of the Year…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle heads for the racecourse full of energy, with power in her every step!
